_comment: Curated fleet-dashboard query set, loaded by muse-server (--metrics-queries-file), rendered as a ConfigMap by the chart. ENGINE- AND TOPOLOGY-AGNOSTIC: each query unions the metric sources present in the fleet via PromQL `or`, so no source is baked into the binary — add engines/proxies by editing this file. Source hierarchy for user-facing SLIs is router (the SMG reverse proxy, `router_*` / `smg_*`, component=router) → engine (`sglang:*` / `vllm:*`, component=engine): the router sees true client-facing traffic (and per-deployment status codes), while the engine sees per-replica internals. Token/latency-breakdown/cache/PD metrics are engine-only (the router emits none). Latency histograms use `_bucket` + histogram_quantile; usage gauges (token_usage, kv_cache_usage_perc) are 0..1 fractions (render as %); PD (prefill/decode) metrics are sglang-only and simply resolve empty on non-PD deployments. All queries group by `inferenceservice` (the deployment), which every layer carries via the ome-inferenceservice-pods scrape relabeling.

queries.promql: sum by (inferenceservice) (rate(router_requests_total[5m])) or sum by (inferenceservice) (rate(sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count[5m])) or sum by (inferenceservice) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count[5m]))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(router_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(router_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(router_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(sglang:queue_time_seconds_bucket[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (inferenceservice, le) (rate(vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_bucket[5m])))
sum by (inferenceservice) (router_pool_inflight_reqs) or sum by (inferenceservice) (sglang:num_running_reqs) or sum by (inferenceservice) (vllm:num_requests_running)

sum by (inferenceservice) (rate(sglang:cached_tokens_total[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (inferenceservice) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_total[5m])), 1) or sum by (inferenceservice) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (inferenceservice) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total[5m])), 1)
